name: jamovi
summary: Free statistics package with spreadsheet editor for common statistical analyses.

usage_guide.open_hint: Open jamovi from your applications menu, or run `flatpak run org.jamovi.jamovi` in a terminal.

Get the R syntax for your analyses

what_it_does.quote: jamovi is a free and open statistics package, which is easy to use, and designed to be familiar to users of SPSS. It provides a spreadsheet editor, and a range of statistical analyses.

who_it_is_for.quote: jamovi - open software to bridge the gap between researcher and statistician

prerequisites.quote: the easiest way to build and work on jamovi, is to build it as a docker container, using [just](https://github.com/casey/just).

first_run_example.quote:
once built, it can be run with:

```bash
just run
```

this launches an embedded web-server, and jamovi can be accessed with a web-browser at the url http://127.0.0.1:41337

evidence.quote: jamovi is an advanced, real-time, statisticial spreadsheet
providing a suite of common statistical methods such as descriptives, t-tests, ANOVAs
